description: The Native M3 Pro is a water purifier built around a simple proposition: pay more upfront and worry less about maintenance. It combines a 10-stage RO+UV system, 100 percent RO processing, a stainless-steel tank, mineralisation, smart monitoring and a built-in battery. In testing, it delivered strong TDS reduction and clean, neutral-tasting water. However, water dispensing is slow, while the three-year filter-life claim remains unproven after a month of use. At Rs. 25,999, it is expensive, but could justify the premium if its maintenance-free promise holds.
title: Native M3 Pro Review: A Premium Water Purifier With One Big Promise to Prove

description: Instagram's dedicated Apple TV app brings Reels, longer videos and live shows to the television screen. Users can search for creators and resume playback across supported devices. The app requires an Apple TV HD or Apple TV 4K running tvOS 26 or later and can be installed through the App Store. However, it does not offer the full range of features found in the mobile app. Users cannot publish posts, Reels or Stories, access direct messages, or leave comments through the TV app.
title: How to Download and Use Instagram on Apple TV: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: The Oppo Enco X4 is among the most convincing premium true wireless earbuds Oppo has brought to India. Its Dynaudio-tuned dual-driver setup delivers clean, detailed sound, with punchy bass, clear vocals, and impressive instrument separation. Active noise cancellation (ANC) works particularly well outdoors, although its strongest setting can feel excessive. Conversation awareness is genuinely useful, automatically lowering music when you start speaking. The earbuds also handle office calls and laptop connectivity reliably, making them as suitable for work as for entertainment. At Rs. 19,999, their biggest compromises are ecosystem-restricted features and reduced battery endurance with ANC enabled.
title: Oppo Enco X4 Review: Premium Sound That Finally Beats the Price Tag

description: Free Fire India has been relaunched in India after the game was banned in the country in 2022. The relaunched version of Free Fire India features 65 characters to choose from. Each character has a special ability. For example, the character named Ray The Watchman is a new addition to the list, offering the Bond of Eclipse special ability. Ray is a male character. Garena’s new Free Fire India is not a very graphically intensive game. You can play the game at lower graphics presets and get a decent gameplay experience. However, you can get a more expensive and gaming-focused device to play at the max graphics preset. According to Free Fire India’s listing on the Google Play Store, it has a download size of 392MB. However, the game will occupy more space on your device’s internal storage. It is compatible with devices running Android 5.0 and newer versions.
title: Free Fire India: Download Size, System Requirements, Features, Characters and More

description: Rising memory prices have made smartphones more expensive, with manufacturers increasingly passing higher component costs on to buyers. This has made finding a capable phone within a fixed budget a little more challenging. This particularly holds true for those looking at the mid-range segment. Samsung, however, still has several smartphones available in India for under Rs. 50,000. Its offerings span its flagship-inspired FE lineup and the more affordable Galaxy A, F, and M series.
title: Best Samsung Smartphones Under Rs. 50,000 in India: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE, Galaxy A56 and More

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro was recently launched in India, competing with the OnePlus 15R and iQOO 15R. The price of the Infinix GT 50 Pro is set at Rs. 69,999. The phone is offered in a single variant, featuring 12GB of RAM and 256GB of onboard storage. The other two phones are notably cheaper. It sports a 6.78-inch 1.5K (1,208x2,644 pixels) LTPS AMOLED display, with up to a 144Hz refresh rate, up to 4,500 nits peak brightness, 2,800Hz instantaneous touch sampling rate, and Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. The handset is also powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro vs iQOO 15R vs OnePlus 15R: Price in India, Specifications and More Compared

description: If you’re a college student, then a laptop is an essential gadget that can end up going everywhere with you. But with so many options to choose from, selecting the right fit for your needs can be a hassle. Despite the memory shortage that has caused prices of smartphones and laptops to skyrocket, you can still find decent thin and light laptops that deliver a good balance between portability, performance, and battery life without spending more than Rs. 1 lakh.
title: Best Thin and Light Laptops Under Rs. 1 Lakh for College Students in India

description: There are many options available in India for under Rs. 20,000, including models from Samsung, Motorola, OnePlus, Realme, and Redmi. Our list of the best value-for-money mobile phones under Rs. 20,000 in India includes the Samsung Galaxy F70 5G, Moto G37 5G, OnePlus N6 Lite 4G, Realme Narzo 100x 5G, and Redmi A7 Pro 5G.
title: Best Value for Money Mobile Phones Under Rs. 20,000 in India: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G, Moto G37 5G and More

description: Reddit is all set to make user logins mandatory for accessing most of its content, according to CEO Steve Huffman. The company plans to move towards a primarily logged-in experience, which will allow it to personalise content recommendations, increase ad income and limit unauthorised data scraping. It will be tested in select markets outside the US in the coming months.
title: Reddit to Require Users to Log in to Browse Platform, Testing to Begin Soon

description: Oppo has begun accepting pre-orders for the Reno 17 series in China ahead of its expected November launch. A teaser reveals a curved display and slim bezels on one of the upcoming smartphones, while the Oppo Pad Air 6 and Oppo Watch 5 have surfaced on the company's Chinese website. The Reno 17 Pro is tipped to feature a 200-megapixel primary camera, a MediaTek Dimensity 8550 chipset and a 7,000mAh battery. The series could reach India in early January 2027.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Series China Launch Set for November, Oppo Pad Air 6 and Watch 5 Teased
